snippet.title: FALLEN (v0.2 Update Trailer)
snippet.description:
Hello!
I am back with FALLEN. I have been updating the game for the past few months to fix and polish all the rough edges, and also adding and changing some stuff too!!
It's not a lot that I have added, mainly because this update was to fix the game so it's in a good playable state compared to the Game Jam version, but now with this, I can focus on actually adding all the new stuff I have planned, so I can make this a full game!

Please read the devlog I wrote over on my Itch.io page for more info: https://kuritoigca.itch.io/fallen/devlog/1308727/new-game-update-after-gamejam-thoughts

I hope you enjoy and look forward to the future of FALLEN!
Thank you for playing if you do so! :)

DOWNLOAD THE GAME HERE: https://kuritoigca.itch.io/fallen

Also, make sure to subscribe to my new gamedev channel! I'll be uploading a dev video of this update there soon! https://www.youtube.com/@UCFrwd0U8YSiqwlqelYCbGeg 

(If you have any feedback for the game, please let me know in the comment section of this video or on the itch.io page! Thank you.)

#horrorgame #itchio #psx
